main_text.p: tatem percipere, Lucrari, Quæstum facere: Commodum, Utilitatem adferre, proficere, prodesse, Utile esse. Aphel אַהְנִי Idem. Ithpahel אִתְהַנִּי, הִתְהַנֶּא Idem. Et in contraria significatione יִתְהַנִּי דִּלְמָא לְמַלְכָּא Ne forte perditio afferatur regi, 2.Sam.17.16.
הַנָּאָה Chald. Utilitas, usus, commoditas, cōmodum, amœnitas.

הַנְיָה, הַנִּיהּ Chald. Idem, Psalm.23,2. Ecclesiast.9.6. מִן הַנִּית מִוִי Ab amœnitate aquarum, Job.14.9. מִן הַנִּית Ab usu balneorum, Levit.23.27. in T.Jon. quomodo etiam legendum cap.16.29. pro הַוִּית.

הִנְדְּקִי Ch. Itidem nomen Regionis. Respondet Hebræo חֵוִילָה in Targ. Jon. & Hierosol. in quo legitur הִנְדְּקִיָא, Genes.25.18. Hinc corrigendus Jonathan Genes. cap.1. v.11. ubi pro eodem Chavilah legitur, הַצְדִּיקִי, sed pravissimè. Unde in eodè Jonathane Genes.10.17. Chavilæ filio Cusch attribuitur, הִנְדְּקִי.
הַנְּרוֹאָה Chald. Æthiops. Ponitur pro Hebræo כּוּשִׁי Jerem.13.23.

הַפָּךְ Chald. & Syr. Vertere, evertere, subvertere, convertere: Convertere se, reverti, redire. avertere se. Aphel אַהְפַּךְ Vertere, convertere, avertere: Redire facere, reducere. Pahel הַפֵּךְ Idem. Item Respondere, Partic. מְהַפְּכִין Qui respondent, Proverb.24.26. Ithpah. אִתְהַפַּךְ Vertere se, verti, converti, Joel.2.31. Ezech.4.8. Item Syrè, Reverti, Mar.13.

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic words are printed in Hebrew letters; the transcription of the Hebrew is approximate in places, and the marginal-looking leading Hebrew headwords are set at line starts. Some vowel points and superscript marks are uncertain. Catchword absent.
